report.what_broke: The background worker container was OOMKilled and restarted due to an unbounded in-process customer cache introduced in v3.9.0.

Since the cache has no size limit, TTL, or eviction policy, it accumulates entries indefinitely as background jobs run, eventually exhausting the container's memory limit and causing an OOM kill.

report.what_broke: p95 latency on the API spiked due to database connection pool exhaustion caused by long-held connections during monthly report exports.

This holds a database connection from the pool for the entire duration of the client download (which can take thousands of seconds), eventually exhausting the connection pool limit of 20 and causing all subsequent API requests to time out waiting for a connection.
